claim: With uniform complete-word weighting supplied, exact pair disagreements identify both not-all-equal holders against arbitrary lawful rivals in all four bare preparations. At every size they recover named words and hence later growth in the proved class, including repeated meetings in a tree of wider holders with two private names per holder and two shared per meeting. All 2,245 reached not-all-equal observations in the census determined their named words and next count.
limits: The first-stage census exhausts starts through ten names and the second-stage census exhausts starts through eight, with age hidden in the comparison. Unrestricted larger stages remain open. Class membership alone, including zero on the explosive draws, does not decide whether a particular pair table is sufficient. Parity can give different births even at equal full states.
